title: Bremer Platz, Münster
description:
All-Inclusive studio apartment for one person or a couple, right in the heart of Münster with modern community areas. 

What does All-inclusive mean?: 
- Utilities
- Electricity
- Super fast WiFi
- Furniture 
- Access to community spaces
- Community events on site (Fitness, Food etc.) 
- Mobile app to manage everything all in one place
- Discounts to local shops
- Anmeldung possible

Yes, this is all included in the price. The goal is to live as a community!

Your Space:
- Queen-sized bed (140x200) 
- Desk 
- Closet and plenty of storage
- Kitchenette 
- High-spec appliances including microwave, hob with exhaust fan and fridge
- Comfy chair
- Full bathroom

Community Spaces:
- Lounge
- Dining Room
- Terrace
- Movie Room
- Glass house
- Laundry Room

Main Terms:
Flexible unlimited contract with a minimum length of 6 months 
One time reservation fee (deducted from the first month’s rent) 

Additional Fees:
Couples: If you’re renting as a couple, there is a 200€ monthly increase.
Pets: If you want to bring your pet friend with you, there is a 50€ monthly charge.


Location:
Located directly at the train station, a hip area of the city that has a young, multicultural scene with a variety of places to eat, cafés and excellent public transport connections. 

Münster Main Train station (2 min walk)
Münster Historic City Centre (15 min walk)
REWE (1 min walk)
Müller (1 min walk)

Photo credits: HEJM Photo, POHA House

title: Julius-Leber-Straße, Münster
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause! Diese geschmackvoll möblierte 2-Zimmer-Wohnung kombiniert modernen Komfort mit zeitlosem Stil und bietet Ihnen ein unvergleichliches Wohnerlebnis.

Der offene Grundriss schafft eine luftige Atmosphäre, während die stilvolle Einrichtung und hochwertige Möbel für ein gemütliches Ambiente sorgen. Die voll ausgestattete Küche lädt dazu ein, kulinarische Meisterwerke zu zaubern, während der Wohnbereich mit bequemen Möbeln und einem Flachbildfernseher den idealen Ort zum Entspannen bietet.

Das geräumige Schlafzimmer ist mit einem komfortablen Bett und reichlich Stauraum ausgestattet, um Ihre persönlichen Dinge ordentlich zu verstauen. Das moderne Badezimmer verfügt über alle Annehmlichkeiten, die Sie benötigen, und eine Waschmaschine steht ebenfalls zur Verfügung.

Genießen Sie zudem entspannte Stunden auf dem Balkon, der einen malerischen Blick auf die Umgebung bietet. Die zentrale Lage ermöglicht es Ihnen, bequem alle Annehmlichkeiten der Stadt zu nutzen, sei es Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Restaurants oder öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

Diese Wohnung bietet mehr als nur ein Dach über dem Kopf – sie bietet einen Lebensstil. Erleben Sie den Luxus und die Bequemlichkeit, in einer komplett möblierten Wohnung zu leben, die darauf wartet, von Ihnen genossen zu werden. Vereinbaren Sie noch heute einen Besichtigungstermin und lassen Sie sich von diesem charmanten Wohnraum verzaubern!

title: Windthorststraße, Münster
description:
If you want to live in the middle of the city, near nearly "everything"  this apartment is right for you
It is located almost "over the roofs" of Münster, on the 4th floor
a doctor's and dentist building in the Windhorststraße, and has 2 almost same size
 rooms (each about 22 square meters), a modern kitchen, bathroom with tub and a
Loggia to the south. From each of the two rooms, you can access this loggia via a balcony door.

In one of the rooms a built-in wall offers a lot of storage space

title: Schlaunstraße, Münster
description:
Perfect & super central apartment for couple or single 45 sqm

Nice and cozy apartment for couple or single in the very center of the City of Münster with the size of 45 sqm. 

The apartment is clean and fully equipped with new furniture and everything you need (e.g. fast WiFi internet, large TV, king size bed, sofa). 

The apartment has a big kitchen with new modern appliances (e.g. ceramic hob, oven, dishwasher, washing machine. In the kitchen you can also sit and dine at the kitchen table. Furthermore, the kitchen is equipped with all necessary cooking utensils. 

The modern, clean, fully tiled and just newly renovated bathroom has a walk-in shower. 

Additional furniture can be provided by the host, like a bigger bed or second bed or what else is desired. 

Towels and bed linen are provided by the host and are included in the booking price. 

The apartment is thoroughly cleaned and prepared for each guest. The city center, the old town, public transport, shopping and dining options are all just around the corner. It takes about 15 minutes to walk to the main train station.

title: Frauenstraße, Münster
description:
super central 1 room and full kitchen apartment 32 sqm

Super central, large 1 room apartment 32 sqm with a modern kitchen in the middle of the city center of Münster.

The city center, old town, public transport, shopping and dining options are all right around the corner. 

The apartment is clean and well equipped with everything (e.g. fast WiFi internet, lagre TV, 140 x 200 cm double bed, sofa, big wardrobe, desk).

The apartment has one big room to live and to sleep in. 

The kitchen is modern with ceramic hob, oven, dishwasher and a washing machine. In the kitchen you can also sit and dine at the kitchen table. Furthermore, the kitchen is equipped with all necessary cooking utensils.

The bedroom is furnished with a double bed (140x200 cm) and fresh linen (pillows, duvet) related. The room has also a sofa, a big wardrobe and a desk to work at. 

Additional furniture can be provided by the host.

The clean, fully tiled bathroom has a shower. Towels and bed linen are provided by the host and are included in the booking price.

The apartment is thoroughly cleaned and prepared for each tenant.

The city center, the old town, public transport, shopping and dining options are all in close proximity. It takes about 15 minutes to walk to the main train station.
